title: Courgette Zucchini 'Eight Ball' F1- 2x Plug Plants | Round Variety
description:
A dwarf, bushy variety that produces large crops of small, round, dark green-skinned fruit. Best harvested when 2-3 inches across, about the size of a tennis ball. Suitable for growing in warm, sheltered positions or under glass. Matures in approximately 50-60 days. 
Cultivation Advice: 
Light: Full sun. Requires a spot protected from strong winds. 
Soil: Well-drained and rich in humus.
